nd follows the session provider.
# dsh-opencode-go-multi-quota
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows **OpenCode Go** quota for **every configured account** under th
e composer, and follows the provider selected in the current session.
中文说明 · DSH plugins
## 中文简介
在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方显示**所有已配置 OpenCode Go 账号**的剩余额度（5 小时 / 每周 / 每月），并跟随当前会话的 provider 自动切换。

- 从 `llm-pi-ai.providers` 自动识别账号，不在插件里写死数量。
- 按账号数自适应：1 个账号用 320px 紧凑卡，2 个账号用 360px 双列矩阵，3 个以上用「当前账号

+ 其他账号」可展开列表，不横向滚动。
- 当前账号列（或当前账号卡）高亮，`限流` 标红，每格带剩余、已用和 `↻` 重置时间。
- 凭据只在 Host 进程解析，页面只拿到百分比；不会下发 ke

y。
- 完整中文说明见 README.zh.md。
## Features
- **Multi-account, auto-detected.** Reads `llm-pi-ai.providers` and picks every provider that looks

like OpenCode Go. No account count in the plugin code.
- **Follows the session provider.** Uses the

session-scoped `modelDirectories` store; switching models swaps the pill immediately.
- **Adaptive l
ayout.** One account uses a 320px compact card; two accounts use a 360px two-column matrix; three or
more use a current-account card plus expandable rows for the others, with no horizontal scrolling.

The active account is highlighted; `rate-limited` cells are marked in red.
- **All the facts, compac
tly.** Each cell shows remaining %, used %, and reset time (`↻`). Same-day resets show only `HH:mm`;

other days show `MM/DD HH:mm`.
- **Per-account cache.** The host caches each provider separately fo

r 60 seconds, and one failing account does not break the others.
- **No keys in the browser.** The h
ost resolves credential refs and calls the usage API; the client only receives percentages.
## How accounts are discovered
On every request the host reads the loaded `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` entry and its `config.provid
ers`. A provider is included when it has an `apiKeyEnv` and any of these is true:
contains `OPENCODE`.
The `apiKeyEnv` value is the credential ref to resolve. Providers with only a stored credential reco
rd and no `apiKeyEnv` are not shown.
If the loader config cannot be read, the host falls back to the two conventional refs `OPENCODE_GO_A
PI_KEY` and `OPENCODE_API_KEY`. A config with no matching provider shows “No OpenCode accounts found
” instead of an endless spinner.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.5` (or a compatible `0.2.x`; see `engines.dsh`).
- At least one OpenCod
e Go provider in `llm-pi-ai.providers` with an `apiKeyEnv` that resolves through DSH credentials or

the environment.
- The standard web client with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection`; the pl
ugin uses it to follow the session provider.

## Host API
The host registers a same-origin read-only route:
| Request | Response |

| `GET /plugin/opencode-go-multi-quota` | Default provider (first discovered, or `opencode-go`) |
|

`GET /plugin/opencode-go-multi-quota?provider=opencode` | One named provider |
| `GET /plugin/openco

de-go-multi-quota?provider=all` | Every discovered account, plus a `detected` flag |
| `...&refresh=
1` | Bypass the 60-second cache |
The upstream endpoint is `GET https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage` with a Bearer token. It is read-o
nly and does not consume plan quota.
## Security and privacy
- Credential values stay in the host process. They are never logged, returned by the route, or sent

to the page.
- The only network request is the usage call to `opencode.ai`; the plugin has no teleme

try.
- The quota route is same-origin and read-only, but it is **not authenticated** and `refresh=1`
bypasses the cache. Do not expose the DSH web server to untrusted networks without adding a proxy o

r auth layer in front of it.
- The auto-discovery rule is intentionally broad. If you have a non-Go
OpenCode provider with an `OPENCODE` ref, it may appear and fail; narrow the rule or remove that pro
vider from `llm-pi-ai.providers`.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The tests use fake API keys and a mocked `fetch`; no real credentials are needed. `test/client.test.
mjs` runs the client module against a tiny hook runtime and a fake model directory, so it checks pro
vider switching and the popover without a browser.
## Compatibility
Built and tested against DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.5`. The plugin uses the client `modelDirectories
` service and the host `loader`, `credentials`, and `webServer` services; breaking changes to those
services will need a plugin update.
